_notes: Native GLB heights are Tripo-normalized (~1 unit); scale with fitHeight to suggestedHeightMeters. Forward axis verified from bind-pose toe joints (rivals) and mesh shape (props). Rival skeletons are Mixamo (mixamorig:*, 65 joints). Clips were exported 'in place'. Only extension used: EXT_texture_webp (+KHR_materials_volume on pie-o-matic and cream-pie). No meshopt/draco needed.

rival-twin.glb.note: Reused from the user's Tripo assets (not generated for Pie Duel). Load twice for the Twins; tint the T-shirt material per seat or add a procedural vest. No defeat clip: use hit_to_head + hold, or idle.

pie-o-matic.glb.note: forward = direction the brass horn points (horn at -x, red lever at +x). Rotate so the horn faces the current target. Single fused mesh: the hopper dome has ~10 pies baked in, so cover/frost it or overlay a procedural hopper; the shell counter must stay procedural.

cream-pie.glb.note: Tall whipped-cream swirl with a cherry (reads more sundae than flat pie). Flatten it with scale.y ~0.6 for the projectile.

spinner-wheel.glb.note: Decorative only: wheel and stand are one fused mesh with 10 uneven wedges. The probability spinner must be procedural.

booth-stall.glb.note: Striped canopy stall with a blank arched sign board; good for the booth set and the level-select midway. Not yet listed in src/models.ts MODEL_FILES.
